question: Where was the FIH Men’s Indoor Hockey World Cup 2018 organised?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Berlin, Germany**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** fifth edition** of the** Men's Indoor Hockey World Cup **took place in **2018.**
 
• In **Berlin, Germany**, it was performed from **February 7 to February 11, 2018.**
 
• **Iran** won their** first medal,** while **Austria overcame Germany** on penalties to win their** first championship.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** 2023 Men's Indoor Hockey World Cup** was the **sixth edition** of this tournament.
 
• It was performed in **Pretoria, South Africa, **from February 5 to February 11, 2023.
 
• After a penalty shootout,** Austria defeated the Netherlands** to win the championship for the second time in a row.
 
• **Iran defeated the United States** to earn the bronze medal.
